decisions.reason: The transactional email service is the flagship of the firm's cloud messaging strategy and fits growing demand for API-based email delivery.
Document capture supports the firm's electronic document workflow direction, though it sits slightly outside the core messaging competence and may be repackaged.
Email-to-fax conversion still serves regulated German customers such as healthcare and public institutions, and it is cheap to run on existing infrastructure.
The fax optimization feature is embedded in the fax service and costs little, but declining fax volumes make it a candidate for consolidation.
Sandbox threat protection addresses rising ransomware threats and strengthens the security portfolio that compliance-focused customers demand.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a core part of the secure email offering and is unlikely to be withdrawn, though it may be bundled into broader security packages.
